inventory_semantics.procedure_and_provenance_exceptions: A1-required final procedure/adoption/source-CSV and scientific MEDIUM prerequisites are explicitly separate placeholder kinds; they are not misrepresented as current run_path direct reads.
inventory_semantics.producer_only: Guarded coordinate source, coordinate producer, coordinate receipt, runtime-evidence receipt and approval-medium producer are preparation/provenance, not current run_path reads; their actual hashes are in v42 report.
inventory_semantics.real: Unique physical files read by run_path code/input/runtime checks and imports; every digest recomputed now. Runtime entries are expanded individually here, not represented solely by runtime JSON hash.
inventory_semantics.self: Manifest is consumed by read_pin(C). Its own full-file digest is computed after creation and supplied externally at anchoring; no self-referential file pin.
